Now I write on topics I enjoy and that is the best part I like about my job.   Know More © X/AlNassr FC At 41, most players would be hanging out their boots when it comes to football. But  Cristiano Ronaldo is still marching on. The former Portugal player is closing in on a historic milestone. With 985 career goals to his name, he needs just 15 to breach the 1000 mark. He shall be the first player to do so.

 Cristiano Ronaldo on the Cusp of Historic First
 But since he does not play international football anymore, Ronaldo has to score all these goals at club level. He is currently plying his trade at Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia, and it could be where his professional career ends. So, can he do it in before 2026 ends?
 © X/AlNassr FC 
 How Many Games Left in 2026?
 Al-Nassr is scheduled to play eight more games this year. The schedule matches are vs Al Ahli (November 20), Al Sadd (November 24), Al Hazem (November 28), Al Qadsiah (December 4), Al Gharafa (December 8), Al Shabab (December 12), Al Fayha (December 16) and Al Kholood (December 20). Of course, there may be changes, but that is how it stands right now. 
 Race Against Time
 It means that Ronaldo has to score close to two goals per game. Not impossible, but very difficult. His contract with Al-Nassr is till June 2027 and it remains to be seen if that is it or if there is an extension or CR7 goes to some other club. Should Ronaldo not be able to reach 1000 goals this year, it will be even more difficult to do it in 2027 as he turns 42 that year. 
 © X/AlNassr FC 
 Cristiano Ronaldoi's International Retirement
 For the unversed, Ronaldo's last game for Portugal was on September 24 vs Wales in the UEFA Nations League. In the wake of a controversy that saw him leave the national camp midway after a tiff with coach  Jorge Jesus , the legend announced his international retirement on November 5. He finished with 146 goals in 234 games, the most in men's football for goals and appearances. 
 Lionel Messi Closest Contender
 Whether or not Ronaldo reaches 1000 goals this year or at all, his legacy is safe. The closest to him is  Lionel Messi with 936. Messi plays in Inter Miami, and he too retired after his last Argentina game vs Benin on October 6.
